name: Thorgas Grimson
summary: Inside Anvilmar in Coldridge Valley, Thorgas Grimson trains new hunters. A seasoned outdoorsman of Dun Morogh, he believes the frozen wilds teach survival best.

sections.title: A Guide in the Cold
sections.body: Thorgas Grimson welcomes new mountaineers and scouts inside Anvilmar. He teaches young hunters to leave dry lectures behind and learn in the freezing winds. With bow or gun in hand, they track Dun Morogh's rugged beasts firsthand.

faq.answer: Thorgas Grimson trains hunters inside Anvilmar, the central outpost of Coldridge Valley in Dun Morogh. He offers new Alliance hunters their first guidance and basic field skills.
Thorgas teaches new hunters wilderness skills, including tracking beasts across snowy terrain and improving their ranged marksmanship. He sets them on the path to becoming mountaineers.
Thorgas believes experience in the wild teaches more than theory. He says hunters must enter the freezing drifts and face Dun Morogh's beasts to master the wild.

faq.q: Will Thorgas Grimson speak with non-hunters?
aliases: can other classes talk to thorgas
faq.answer: Thorgas politely tells adventurers of other callings that he cannot train them. He advises them to seek a mentor suited to their path.

angles.text: As a dwarf hunter, you may meet Thorgas Grimson as your first mentor. He offers early guidance in tracking beasts and surviving the freezing valley.
As a dwarf, you share the hardy, self-reliant spirit of the Ironforge mountaineers who patrol Dun Morogh's frozen peaks.
